tools.name: toronto-building-permit-checker
tools.description: Says whether a project in Toronto needs a building permit, usually does not, or depends, with the City source for the answer. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/toronto-building-permit-checker?project=deck&h=high&att=yes&exit=no

tools.name: garden-suite-zoning-checker
tools.description: Checks height, separation, floor area, setbacks and lot coverage of a garden suite against Toronto By-law 849-2025. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/garden-suite-zoning-checker?zone=yes&laneway=no&lot_area=400&lot_depth=40&lot_frontage=10&house_gfa=180&house_footprint=90&ancillary_foot

tools.name: toronto-permit-review-time-calculator
tools.description: Gives the last day of the City of Toronto published review time for a complete building permit application, by review stream. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/toronto-permit-review-time-calculator?stream=house&date=2026-12-01&zoning_certificate=yes

tools.name: accessible-ramp-and-doorway-calculator
tools.description: Ramp length for a rise at the Ontario Building Code 1 in 12 gradient, a slope check, or a doorway clear width check, using Section 3.8. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/accessible-ramp-and-doorway-calculator?mode=len&units=mm&rise=600

tools.name: bathroom-exhaust-fan-calculator
tools.description: Minimum bathroom exhaust fan rating in CFM from room size, ceiling height and fixtures, using the Home Ventilating Institute guidance. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/bathroom-exhaust-fan-calculator?units=ft&length=8&width=10&height=8

tools.name: basement-ceiling-height-and-egress-checker
tools.description: Tests basement ceiling height, height under beams and ducts, and stair headroom against Ontario Building Code Part 9, for a house basement or a secondary suite. Window sizes are tested by the egress window size calculator. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/basement-ceiling-height-and-eg

tools.name: egress-window-size-calculator
tools.description: Tests a bedroom escape window against Ontario Building Code Article 9.9.10.1: open area of at least 0.35 m2, no dimension under 380 mm, sill height and window well clearance. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/egress-window-size-calculator?units=mm&type=casement&width=600&height=700&floo

tools.name: second-suite-requirements-checklist
tools.description: A checklist of Ontario Building Code, Planning Act, Fire Code and City of Toronto items to check before adding a secondary suite to a house, each with its section number. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/second-suite-requirements-checklist?building=detached&smaller=yes&units_now=1&loca

tools.name: deck-permit-and-guard-checker-toronto
tools.description: Says whether a deck in Toronto needs a building permit, whether a guard is required, the minimum guard height, opening size and stair handrail rule, from the City of Toronto and Ontario Building Code Part 9. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/deck-permit-and-guard-checker-toronto?units=m

tools.name: stair-calculator-ontario
tools.description: Gives the number of risers allowed for a total rise, the rise and run of each option, and tests headroom and width against Ontario Building Code Part 9 Section 9.8. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/stair-calculator-ontario?units=mm&type=private&rise=2600&run=3500&headroom=1980&width=90

tools.name: renovation-materials-calculator
tools.description: How much paint, how many drywall sheets or how many boxes of flooring a rectangular room needs, with an adjustable waste allowance. Quantities only. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/renovation-materials-calculator?material=paint&units=ft&length=12&width=10&height=8&openings=40&coats=2&
